# Manage credentials

## Summary

Store and share the authentication details your workflows need, without spreading secrets across your instance.

**Source**: https://docs.n8n.io/administer/manage-credentials.md

---

Store and share the authentication details your workflows need, without spreading secrets across your instance.

## In this section

* [Share credentials securely](/administer/manage-credentials/share-credentials-securely): share credentials within an organization.
* [End-user credentials](/administer/manage-credentials/end-user-credentials): let each user connect their own account to a credential.
* [Credential overwrites](/administer/manage-credentials/credential-overwrites): set credential data globally on a self-hosted instance.
* [Use external secret stores](/administer/manage-credentials/use-external-secret-stores): use an external secrets vault with n8n.
